P1.title: The Sea
P1.text:
Three-fourths of the surface of our planet is covered by the sea, which both separates and unites the various races of mankind. The sea is the great highway along which man may journey at his will; the great road that has no walls or hedges hemming it in, and that nobody has to keep in good repair with the aid of pickaxes and barrels of tar and steamrollers. The sea appeals to man's love of the perilous and the unknown, to his love of conquest, his love of knowledge, and his love of gold. It is green, and grey, and blue and purple water calls to him and bids him fare forth in quest of fresh fields. Beyond his horizon he has found danger and death, glory and gain.

In some great continents such as America and Australia, there are towns and villages many thousands of miles from the coast, whose children have never seen or heard the waves of the sea. But in the British Isles there is nowhere much more than a hundred miles from the most inland spot. The love of the sea is in the very blood of the British people.

P2.title: Civilization
P2.text:
One of the greatest delusions of modern times is the prevailing belief that we are more civilized than our ancestors. Never in the history of mankind has the word "Civilization" been so often misused and misunderstood. It is not in the abundance of material goods alone that civilization lies. Neither does it consist in the advance of scientific knowledge however amazing it may be. The inventions and discoveries of science have undoubtedly brought unheard blessings and comforts to us. But they are not civilization. What we have failed to see is that civilization is a special way of human behaviour, thoughts and feelings. The essential quality of civilization lies in the spirit of human beings, in their attitude to themselves, to their fellow human beings and to life as a whole.

Looking everywhere around us today, we will find that human beings have made little progress since the dawn of history in their attitudes towards their fellow human beings. On the highest pillars in the cities of the world, you will find the figure of a conqueror or a general. We know more about our killers and destroyers than about our saviours and saints. The heroes of the world are the heroes of war.

GP1.title: The Value of Time
GP1.text: Time is the most precious thing in the world. Once a moment is gone, it can never be recovered. Many people waste their time in idleness and later regret it. Those who use their time wisely achieve great success in life. A student who studies regularly, a farmer who works in season, and a worker who is punctual all understand the value of time. Time and tide wait for none.

GP2.title: Forests and Life
GP2.text: Forests are essential for life on earth. They give us oxygen, timber, medicine and shelter for wildlife. Trees absorb carbon dioxide and help control climate change. When forests are cut down, soil erosion increases and rivers dry up. Protecting forests is therefore protecting our own future. Everyone should plant trees and prevent deforestation.

GP3.title: Honesty
GP3.text: Honesty is the best policy. An honest person is respected everywhere, even by enemies. Though a dishonest person may prosper for a short time, he is finally exposed and loses everyone's trust. Honesty brings peace of mind and lasting friendships. It is the foundation of a good character and a strong society.

GP4.title: Exercise and Health
GP4.text: Regular exercise keeps the body fit and the mind alert. It improves blood circulation, strengthens muscles and reduces the risk of many diseases. People who exercise daily sleep better and feel more energetic. A short walk, cycling or simple stretching can make a big difference. Health is wealth, and exercise is the cheapest medicine.

GP5.title: Discipline
GP5.text: Discipline is the backbone of a nation. Without it, no society can progress. In the army, in schools and in offices, discipline ensures order and efficiency. A disciplined person respects rules, values time and controls his desires. Nature itself is disciplined: the sun rises and sets at fixed times, and the seasons follow one another in order. If we learn discipline from nature, we can build a peaceful and prosperous society.

GP6.title: The Importance of Reading
GP6.text: Reading is one of the best habits a person can develop. Books are a treasure of knowledge and experience. Through reading we can travel to distant lands, meet great minds and learn from the past without leaving our room. A good book is a faithful friend that never deserts us. Those who read widely think clearly and speak well. Therefore, we should make reading a part of our daily life.

GP7.title: Water Conservation
GP7.text: Water is life. Although three-fourths of the earth is covered with water, only a small part of it is fit for drinking. Rapid population growth, pollution and waste have created a shortage of clean water in many parts of the world. We must not waste water. Closing taps, harvesting rainwater and preventing pollution of rivers are simple ways to save water. Saving water today means saving life tomorrow.

GP8.title: Hard Work
GP8.text: There is no substitute for hard work. Talent alone cannot bring success; it must be supported by effort. Many gifted people have failed because they were lazy, while ordinary people have risen high through sheer labour. Hard work builds confidence and character. It turns dreams into reality. The farmer who ploughs his field and the student who studies late both know that success is the reward of toil.

GP9.title: Pollution
GP9.text: Pollution is one of the greatest problems of the modern world. Air, water and soil are all being poisoned by human activity. Factories release harmful gases, vehicles emit smoke, and plastic waste chokes our rivers. Pollution causes diseases, destroys wildlife and warms the planet. To fight it, we must use clean energy, plant trees and reduce waste. The earth is our only home, and it is our duty to protect it.

GP10.title: Kindness
GP10.text: Kindness costs nothing but means everything. A gentle word, a helping hand or a warm smile can change someone's whole day. The world remembers not the powerful but the compassionate. Kindness spreads from person to person like light. Even animals respond to gentle treatment. A kind heart is the fountain of gladness, making everything in its vicinity fresh and beautiful.

GP11.title: Newspapers
GP11.text: Newspapers play a vital role in a democracy. They inform the public about national and world events, expose corruption and shape public opinion. A free press is often called the fourth pillar of the state. However, newspapers must report the truth honestly and avoid spreading rumours. A responsible reader also checks facts before believing everything printed. In the age of the internet, this responsibility is greater than ever.

GP12.title: Tourism in Nepal
GP12.text: Nepal is a paradise for tourists. From the snowy peaks of the Himalayas to the green plains of the Terai, the country offers stunning natural beauty. Tourists come for trekking, mountaineering, wildlife safaris and to visit ancient temples. Tourism is a major source of foreign income and employment. However, unmanaged tourism can harm the environment. Therefore, Nepal must promote sustainable and responsible tourism.

GP13.title: Science and Society
GP13.text: Science has transformed human life. It has given us electricity, medicine, fast transport and instant communication. Diseases that once killed millions are now curable. Yet science is a double-edged sword. The same knowledge that cures can also destroy, as seen in nuclear weapons. Science itself is neither good nor bad; it is the use we make of it that matters. Wisdom must guide our scientific power.

GP14.title: Friendship
GP14.text: A true friend is one of life's greatest blessings. Friendship is not measured by the time spent together but by the trust and understanding shared. A real friend stands by us in trouble, tells us the truth even when it hurts, and rejoices in our success without envy. False friends flatter us in good times and desert us in bad. We should therefore choose our friends with care and be loyal to them.

GP15.title: Education
GP15.text: Education is the most powerful weapon to change the world. It removes ignorance, builds character and opens the door to opportunity. True education is not merely the collection of facts but the training of the mind to think. An educated person is not necessarily one with many degrees, but one who can distinguish right from wrong. The aim of education is to make us better human beings.

GP16.title: The Value of Trees
GP16.text: Trees are the lungs of the earth. They give out oxygen, which all living beings need to breathe, and take in carbon dioxide. Trees provide food, shade, timber and homes for countless creatures. Their roots hold the soil together and prevent floods. Where forests are destroyed, land turns to desert. Planting trees is therefore one of the greatest services we can do for the planet and for future generations.

GP17.title: Health
GP17.text: Good health is the greatest of all blessings. A healthy person can work, think and enjoy life, while a sick person suffers even in the midst of wealth. Health depends on clean food, pure water, fresh air, regular exercise and enough sleep. Bad habits like smoking and overeating destroy health slowly. We should take care of our body as we take care of a valuable machine, for health once lost is hard to regain.

GP18.title: Unity
GP18.text: Unity is strength. A single stick can easily be broken, but a bundle of sticks cannot. When people stand together, they can face any difficulty. History shows that divided nations fall while united ones prosper. In a family, a school or a country, cooperation brings success and quarrels bring ruin. We must therefore learn to live together in harmony, forgetting small differences for the common good.

questions.exp: तिब्बतको राजधानी ल्हासालाई लामो समय बाहिरी संसारका लागि बन्द राखिएकाले 'निषेधित सहर' भनिन्छ। (बेइजिङको दरबार परिसरलाई पनि Forbidden City भनिन्छ, तर सहरका रूपमा ल्हासा नै चिनिन्छ।)

questions.qn: सुर्खेत, जाजरकोट, सिन्धुली र मोरङमध्ये नेपालका कुन जिल्लाहरूको सिमाना भारतसँग जोडिएको छैन?
questions.qe: Among Surkhet, Jajarkot, Sindhuli and Morang, which districts of Nepal do NOT share a border with India?
questions.exp: मोरङको सिमाना भारतसँग जोडिन्छ। सिन्धुली भित्री मधेशमा पर्ने भए पनि यसको दक्षिणी सीमा नजिक छ तर यहाँको सही उत्तर सुर्खेत र जाजरकोट हो — दुवै मध्य पहाडी जिल्ला भएकाले भारतसँग सिमाना जोडिँदैन।

questions.qn: हरित पेटिका अभियान (Green Belt Movement) का संस्थापक को हुन्?
questions.qe: Who is the founder of the Green Belt Movement?
questions.exp: केन्याकी वंगारी माथाईले सन् १९७७ मा Green Belt Movement सुरु गर्नुभयो र सन् २००४ मा नोबेल शान्ति पुरस्कार पाउनुभयो।

questions.qn: एजेण्डा २१ केसँग सम्बन्धित छ?
questions.qe: Agenda 21 is related to which of the following?
questions.exp: एजेण्डा २१ सन् १९९२ को रियो पृथ्वी सम्मेलन (UNCED) बाट पारित दिगो विकास तथा वातावरण संरक्षणसम्बन्धी कार्ययोजना हो।

questions.qn: साइटिस (CITES) केसँग सम्बन्धित छ?
questions.qe: CITES is related to which of the following?
opt: Conservation of endangered species of wild fauna and flora
questions.exp: CITES (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species) ले लोपोन्मुख वन्यजन्तु र वनस्पतिको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय व्यापार नियन्त्रण गर्दछ। मुख्यालय जेनेभामा छ।

questions.qn: भियना महासन्धि र यसको मोन्ट्रियल प्रोटोकलको मुख्य उद्देश्य निम्नमध्ये कुन हो?
questions.qe: What is the main objective of the Vienna Convention and its Montreal Protocol?
questions.exp: भियना महासन्धि (१९८५) र मोन्ट्रियल प्रोटोकल (१९८७) ओजन तह क्षय गर्ने पदार्थ (ODS) को नियन्त्रणमार्फत ओजन तह संरक्षण गर्न केन्द्रित छन्।

questions.qn: निम्नलिखितमध्ये कुन चाहिँ 'जलवायु आपतकालीन' घोषणा गर्ने पहिलो देश थियो?
questions.qe: Which of the following was the first country to declare a 'Climate Emergency'?
questions.exp: सन् २०१९ मे १ मा बेलायतको संसदले जलवायु आपतकाल घोषणा गर्‍यो — यसो गर्ने विश्वको पहिलो राष्ट्रिय संसद थियो।

questions.qn: 'Aichi Targets' केसँग सम्बन्धित छ?
questions.qe: 'Aichi Targets' are related to which of the following?
questions.exp: जैविक विविधता महासन्धि (CBD) अन्तर्गत सन् २०१० मा जापानको Aichi मा भएको COP-10 ले सन् २०११–२०२० का लागि २० वटा जैविक विविधता लक्ष्य तय गरेको थियो।

questions.qn: तलका मध्ये सबैभन्दा पहिले स्थापना भएको संरक्षण क्षेत्र कुन हो?
questions.qe: Which of the following conservation areas was established first?
questions.exp: अन्नपूर्ण संरक्षण क्षेत्र सन् १९८६ (वि.सं. २०४२) मा स्थापना भएको नेपालको पहिलो र सबैभन्दा ठूलो संरक्षण क्षेत्र हो।

questions.qn: मुख्यतः देहायको कुन हरितगृह ग्यास होइन?
questions.qe: Which of the following is mainly NOT a greenhouse gas?
questions.exp: नाइट्रोजन (N₂) वायुमण्डलको सबैभन्दा प्रचुर ग्यास भए पनि अवरक्त विकिरण सोस्न नसक्ने भएकाले हरितगृह ग्यास होइन।

questions.qn: उत्पादन क्षमताको आधारमा ठूलोबाट सानो जलविद्युत आयोजनाको क्रम कुन सही हो?
questions.qe: On the basis of production capacity, choose the correct order of hydropower projects in descending order.
questions.exp: कालीगण्डकी 'ए' (१४४ MW) → मर्स्याङ्दी (६९ MW) → खिम्ती (६० MW) → भोटेकोशी (४५ MW) → चिलिमे (२२ MW)।

questions.qn: उत्पादन क्षमताको आधारमा देहायका जलविद्युत आयोजनाहरूको सही क्रम (बढीदेखि कम) छनौट गर्नुहोस्।
questions.qe: Choose the correct order (highest to lowest) of the following hydropower projects based on production capacity.
questions.exp: कालीगण्डकी 'ए' (१४४ MW) → मध्यमर्स्याङ्दी (७० MW) → खिम्ती (६० MW) → चमेलिया (३० MW)।

questions.qn: तेह्रौं योजनाको अन्त्यसम्ममा कति प्रतिशत जनसंख्यालाई विद्युतमा पहुँच पुर्‍याउने लक्ष्य थियो?
questions.qe: To what percentage of population was access to electricity targeted by the end of the Thirteenth Plan?
questions.exp: तेह्रौं योजना (२०७०/७१–२०७२/७३) ले योजना अवधिको अन्त्यसम्ममा ८७ प्रतिशत जनसंख्यालाई विद्युत पहुँच पुर्‍याउने लक्ष्य राखेको थियो।

questions.qn: तेह्रौं योजनामा कृषि क्षेत्रको वार्षिक औसत वृद्धिदर कति हासिल गर्ने लक्ष्य लिइएको थियो?
questions.qe: What annual average growth rate of the agriculture sector was targeted in the Thirteenth Plan?
questions.exp: तेह्रौं योजनाले कृषि क्षेत्रको वार्षिक औसत वृद्धिदर ४.५ प्रतिशत हासिल गर्ने लक्ष्य लिएको थियो।

questions.qn: प्राइम कस्ट (Prime cost) भनेको के हो?
questions.qe: What is 'Prime cost'?
opt: विक्रेताले कारोबार गर्न तयार हुने मूल्य
The price at which a seller is ready to trade
प्रत्यक्ष खरिद सामान, श्रम र खर्चको कुल लागत
Total of direct materials, direct labour and direct expenses
Contract for purchase and sale of property
questions.exp: Prime cost = प्रत्यक्ष कच्चा पदार्थ + प्रत्यक्ष श्रम + प्रत्यक्ष खर्च। यसमा अप्रत्यक्ष (overhead) लागत समावेश हुँदैन।

questions.qn:
समूह I र समूह II बाट उपयुक्त जोडा मिलाउनुहोस्:
समूह I: (a) JICA  (b) DFID  (c) USAID  (d) Helvetas Nepal
समूह II: १. स्वीट्जरल्याण्ड  २. संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका  ३. बेलायत  ४. जापान
questions.qe: Match Group I (donor agencies) with Group II (countries) and select the correct code.
questions.exp: JICA — जापान (४), DFID — बेलायत (३), USAID — अमेरिका (२), Helvetas — स्वीट्जरल्याण्ड (१)।

questions.qn: हुलाकी लोकमार्ग आयोजनाले कुनदेखि कुनसम्मको भूभाग ओगटेको छ?
questions.qe: The Hulaki (Postal) Highway project covers which stretch?
opt: From Kechana of Jhapa to Dodhara Chandani of Kanchanpur
From Biratnagar of Morang to Dhangadhi of Kailali
From Damak of Jhapa to Belauri of Kanchanpur
From Inaruwa of Sunsari to Mahendranagar of Kanchanpur
questions.exp: हुलाकी राजमार्ग तराईको दक्षिणी भागबाट पूर्वमा झापाको केचनाकवलदेखि पश्चिममा कञ्चनपुरको दोधारा-चाँदनीसम्म फैलिएको छ।

questions.qn: कुन मुद्रालाई 'Paper Gold' भनेर बुझिन्छ?
questions.qe: Which currency is known as 'Paper Gold'?
questions.exp: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मुद्रा कोषले सन् १९६९ मा सिर्जना गरेको Special Drawing Rights (SDR) लाई 'Paper Gold' भनिन्छ।

questions.qn: आर्थिक विकास तथा प्रशासन केन्द्र (CEDA) कुन देशको सहयोगमा स्थापना भएको हो?
questions.qe: CEDA was established in the cooperation of which country?
questions.exp: त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय अन्तर्गतको Centre for Economic Development and Administration (CEDA) सन् १९६९ मा अमेरिकी सहयोगमा स्थापना भएको थियो।

questions.qn: युनेस्कोको प्रधान कार्यालय कहाँ रहेको छ?
questions.qe: The headquarters of UNESCO is at …
questions.exp: UNESCO को मुख्यालय फ्रान्सको पेरिसमा छ। स्थापना: १६ नोभेम्बर १९४५।

questions.qn: साइटिस (CITES) को प्रधान कार्यालय कहाँ छ?
questions.qe: Where is the headquarters of CITES?
questions.exp: CITES सचिवालय स्वीट्जरल्याण्डको जेनेभामा रहेको छ र यसको प्रशासन UNEP ले गर्दछ।

questions.qn: नेपाल सर्वप्रथम कहिले संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघको शान्ति सेनामा सहभागी भएको थियो?
questions.qe: When did Nepal participate in United Nations Peacekeeping Operations for the first time?
questions.exp: नेपालले सन् १९५८ मा लेबनानमा UNOGIL मा सैनिक पर्यवेक्षक पठाएर पहिलोपटक संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघीय शान्ति स्थापना कार्यमा सहभागिता जनाएको थियो।

questions.qn: असंलग्न राष्ट्रहरूको १६औं सम्मेलन कुन देशमा भएको थियो?
questions.qe: Where was the 16th Summit of Non-Aligned countries held?
questions.exp: असंलग्न आन्दोलनको १६औं शिखर सम्मेलन सन् २०१२ मा इरानको तेहरानमा सम्पन्न भएको थियो।

questions.qn: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघको बडापत्रमा कति धारा छन्?
questions.qe: How many articles are there in the Charter of the United Nations?
questions.exp: संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघको बडापत्रमा १९ अध्याय र १११ धारा रहेका छन्। यो २४ अक्टोबर १९४५ देखि लागू भयो।

questions.qn: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय श्रम संगठन (ILO) ले कहिले नोबेल शान्ति पुरस्कार प्राप्त गरेको थियो?
questions.qe: When did the International Labour Organization receive the Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.exp: ILO ले आफ्नो स्थापनाको ५०औं वार्षिकोत्सव सन् १९६९ मा नोबेल शान्ति पुरस्कार प्राप्त गरेको थियो।

questions.qn:
निम्न देशहरूका बारेमा विचार गर्नुहोस्: १. ब्रुनाई  २. भियतनाम  ३. लाओस  ४. म्यानमार
आसियान (ASEAN) का सदस्य माथि उल्लिखित देशहरूमा कुन हुन्?
questions.qe: Consider the following countries: 1. Brunei 2. Vietnam 3. Laos 4. Myanmar. Which of them are members of ASEAN?
questions.exp: आसियानका १० सदस्य: ब्रुनाई, कम्बोडिया, इण्डोनेसिया, लाओस, मलेसिया, म्यानमार, फिलिपिन्स, सिंगापुर, थाइल्याण्ड र भियतनाम। चारै देश सदस्य हुन्।

questions.qn: सार्कको अठारौं शिखर सम्मेलनमा सबै आठ सदस्य राष्ट्रले औपचारिक सम्झौता गरी सहमति गरेको विषय कुन हो?
questions.qe: During the 18th SAARC Summit, on which theme did all eight member countries agree by a formal agreement?
questions.exp: सन् २०१४ मा काठमाडौँमा भएको १८औं सार्क शिखर सम्मेलनमा 'SAARC Framework Agreement on Energy Cooperation (Electricity)' मा हस्ताक्षर भएको थियो।

questions.qn: BIMSTEC मा नेपाल कहिले औपचारिक रूपमा पूर्ण सदस्यका रूपमा प्रवेश गरेको हो?
questions.qe: When did Nepal formally join BIMSTEC as a full member?
questions.exp: नेपाल सन् १९९८ मा पर्यवेक्षक बनेको थियो र फेब्रुअरी २००४ मा पूर्ण सदस्यका रूपमा BIMSTEC मा प्रवेश गर्‍यो।

questions.qn: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय अणुशक्ति आयोग (IAEA) को प्रधान कार्यालय कहाँ रहेको छ?
questions.qe: Where is the headquarters of the International Atomic Energy Agency located?
questions.exp: IAEA को मुख्यालय अस्ट्रियाको भियनामा छ। स्थापना: सन् १९५७।

questions.qn: ओलम्पिक संग्रहालय निम्न स्थानहरूमध्ये कहाँ खोलिएको छ?
questions.qe: Where has the Olympic Museum been established?
questions.exp: ओलम्पिक संग्रहालय स्वीट्जरल्याण्डको लजानमा छ, जहाँ अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय ओलम्पिक समिति (IOC) को मुख्यालय पनि रहेको छ।

questions.qn: युरोपियन युनियनबाट बेलायत अलग हुने सम्बन्धमा Brexit जनमत संग्रह कहिले भएको थियो?
questions.qe: When was the Brexit referendum on the United Kingdom leaving the European Union held?
questions.exp: २३ जुन २०१६ मा भएको जनमत संग्रहमा ५१.९% मतदाताले युरोपियन युनियन छोड्ने पक्षमा मत दिएका थिए।

questions.qn:
संगठन र मुख्यालयबीच जोडा मिलाउनुहोस्:
(a) संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघीय विश्वविद्यालय  (b) विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO)  (c) अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मुद्रा कोष (IMF)  (d) संयुक्त राष्ट्रसंघीय वातावरण कार्यक्रम (UNEP)
१. जेनेभा  २. वासिङ्टन डी.सी.  ३. नैरोबी  ४. टोकियो
questions.qe: Match the organization with its headquarters and select the correct answer.
questions.exp: UNU — टोकियो (४), WTO — जेनेभा (१), IMF — वासिङ्टन डी.सी. (२), UNEP — नैरोबी (३)।

questions.qn: विश्व इतिहासमा मानव अधिकारको सम्बन्धमा पहिलो लिखित दस्तावेजका रूपमा के लाई मानिन्छ?
questions.qe: In world history, which is regarded as the first written document related to human rights?
questions.exp: सन् १२१५ मा इङ्ल्याण्डमा जारी भएको म्याग्नाकार्टालाई मानव अधिकारसम्बन्धी पहिलो लिखित दस्तावेज मानिन्छ।

questions.qn: दोस्रो विश्वयुद्धको अन्त्यसँगै विभाजन भएको कुन मुलुक शीतयुद्धको अन्त्यसँगै पुनः एकीकरण भयो?
questions.qe: Which country, divided at the end of the Second World War, was reunified at the end of the Cold War?
questions.exp: सन् १९४५ मा विभाजित जर्मनी सन् १९९० अक्टोबर ३ मा पुनः एकीकृत भयो। बर्लिन पर्खाल १९८९ नोभेम्बर ९ मा ढालिएको थियो।

questions.qn: टेलिभिजनको आविष्कार कसले गरेका हुन्?
questions.qe: Who invented Television?
questions.exp: स्कटिस इन्जिनियर जोन लोगी बेयर्डले सन् १९२५–२६ मा पहिलो कार्यशील टेलिभिजन प्रणाली प्रदर्शन गरेका थिए।

questions.qn: जापानको हिरोसिमामा August 6, 1945 मा विस्फोट गरिएको परमाणु बमको नाम के हो?
questions.qe: What was the name of the atom bomb exploded in Hiroshima on August 6, 1945?
questions.exp: हिरोसिमामा 'Little Boy' (युरेनियम बम) र नागासाकीमा ९ अगस्टमा 'Fat Man' (प्लुटोनियम बम) खसालिएको थियो।

questions.qn: वस्तुको तौल निम्नमध्ये कुन ठाउँमा लगियो भने उल्लेखनीय किसिमले वृद्धि हुन्छ?
questions.qe: The weight of an object will increase significantly if it is taken …
opt: To the top of a mountain
To the centre of the earth

questions.qn:
The following questions are based on a bar chart showing means used by school children:

How many more children travelled by bus than by cycle?

questions.exp: बसबाट २६ जना, साइकलबाट १५ जना → फरक = 26 − 15 = ११ जना।

questions.qn: Choose the word that is most nearly OPPOSITE in meaning to the word in capital letters: CONSOLIDATION
questions.qe: CONSOLIDATION
questions.exp: Consolidation = एकीकरण/सुदृढीकरण। यसको विपरीत fragmentation = टुक्रिनु/विखण्डन।

questions.qn: Choose the word that is most nearly OPPOSITE in meaning: SECURE
questions.qe: SECURE
questions.exp: Secure (क्रियापद) = कस्नु/बलियोसँग बाँध्नु। यसको विपरीत unfasten = खुकुलो पार्नु/खोल्नु।

questions.qn: Choose the word that is most nearly OPPOSITE in meaning: VALOR
questions.qe: VALOR
questions.exp: Valor = वीरता/साहस। यसको विपरीत cowardice = कायरता।

questions.qn: Choose the word that is most nearly OPPOSITE in meaning: UNEARTH
questions.qe: UNEARTH
questions.exp: Unearth = खनेर निकाल्नु/पत्ता लगाउनु। यसको विपरीत conceal = लुकाउनु।

questions.qn: Choose the word that is most nearly OPPOSITE in meaning: LAVISH
questions.qe: LAVISH
questions.exp: Lavish = फजुल खर्ची/प्रचुर। यसको विपरीत frugal = मितव्ययी।

questions.qn: Choose the right alternative for the underlined phrase: Prices are going up __by leaps and bounds__.
questions.qe: Prices are going up by leaps and bounds.
questions.exp: 'By leaps and bounds' एउटा idiom हो जसको अर्थ अत्यन्त छिटो/द्रुत गतिले (rapidly) हो।

questions.qn: Indefatigable means
questions.qe: Indefatigable means
questions.exp: Indefatigable = नथाक्ने, अविचल — अर्थात् never giving up / tireless।

questions.qn: This passage is beyond my ability to understand. It is ………
questions.qe: This passage is beyond my ability to understand. It is ………
questions.exp: Impenetrable = बुझ्न नसकिने, अभेद्य। बुझ्न नसक्ने पाठलाई impenetrable भनिन्छ।

questions.qn: A Lacto-vegetarian is one who?
questions.qe: A Lacto-vegetarian is one who?
opt: Avoids all types of meat, fish or egg products but eats animal products made from milk.
Avoids milk products but eats vegetables.
questions.exp: 'Lacto' = दूध सम्बन्धी। Lacto-vegetarian ले मासु, माछा र अण्डा त्याग्छ तर दुग्धजन्य पदार्थ खान्छ।

questions.qn: ……… substances should be kept away.
questions.qe: ……… substances should be kept away.
questions.exp: टाढा राख्नुपर्ने भनेको खतरनाक पदार्थ हो → Hazardous। अरू तीनवटै सकारात्मक अर्थका शब्द हुन्।

questions.qn: Choose the right verb/pronoun to show antecedents and other agreement: Two ladies had ……… hand bags stolen at the seminar.
questions.qe: Two ladies had ……… hand bags stolen at the seminar.
questions.exp: 'Two ladies' बहुवचन भएकाले बहुवचन possessive pronoun 'their' चाहिन्छ।

questions.qn: Which of the following sentences is grammatically right?
questions.qe: Which of the following sentences is grammatically right?
opt: I am unable to return I don't complete my mission.
I am unable to return unless I complete my mission.
I am unable to return unless I don't complete my mission.
I am able to return I complete my mission.
questions.exp: 'Unless' आफैँमा नकारात्मक अर्थ बोक्ने भएकाले यससँग फेरि 'don't' प्रयोग गर्नु दोहोरो नकारात्मक हुन्छ। सही रूप: 'unless I complete my mission'।

questions.qn: Which of the following is a noun?
questions.qe: Which of the following is a noun?
questions.exp: Heighten र abbreviate क्रियापद (verb) हुन्, perceptual विशेषण (adjective) हो। Ignorance मात्र नाम (noun) हो।

questions.qn: Choose the correct alternative of the given sentence for indirect speech: He said, "I clean my teeth twice a day."
questions.qe: He said, "I clean my teeth twice a day." — indirect speech?
opt: He said that he cleaned his teeth twice a day.
He said that he cleans his teeth twice a day.
He said that used to cleaned his teeth twice a day.
He said that he used to cleaning his teeth twice a day.
questions.exp: Reporting verb भूतकाल ('said') मा भएकाले reported clause को present simple ('clean') past simple ('cleaned') मा परिवर्तन हुन्छ।

questions.qn: Take an umbrella ……… it rains.
questions.qe: Take an umbrella ……… it rains.
questions.exp: 'In case' ले सम्भावित घटनाको पूर्वतयारी जनाउँछ — 'पानी पर्न सक्छ, त्यसैले छाता लैजानू'।

questions.qn: I am too tired for a walk ……… it looks like rain.
questions.qe: I am too tired for a walk ……… it looks like rain.
questions.exp: 'Besides' = यसबाहेक/थप कारण थप्न प्रयोग हुन्छ। 'Beside' को अर्थ छेउमा हो, जुन यहाँ मिल्दैन।

questions.qn: The king was travelling in ……… nobody recognizing him.
questions.qe: The king was travelling in ……… nobody recognizing him.
questions.exp: 'In disguise' = भेष बदलेर। राजाले भेष बदलेकाले कसैले चिनेनन्।

questions.qn: I live ……… kind of chocolates.
questions.qe: I live ……… kind of chocolates.
questions.exp: 'Kind' एकवचन भएकाले एकवचन determiner 'this' चाहिन्छ — 'this kind of chocolates'।

questions.qn: The dog runs ……… squirrels.
questions.qe: The dog runs ……… squirrels.

questions.qn: They are kind; ………?
questions.qe: They are kind; ………?
questions.exp: सकारात्मक वाक्यको question tag नकारात्मक हुन्छ र सहायक क्रिया 'are' दोहोरिन्छ → 'aren't they'।

questions.qn: He had better ……… the river water level is rising.
questions.qe: He had better ……… the river water level is rising.
questions.exp: 'Had better' पछि 'to' बिनाको आधार क्रिया (bare infinitive) आउँछ → 'had better stop'। 'Stop' पछि गतिविधि रोक्ने अर्थमा gerund 'swimming' आउँछ।

questions.qn: I haven't got a ticket. If ……… one, I could get in.
questions.qe: I haven't got a ticket. If ……… one, I could get in.
questions.exp: यो Second Conditional हो — वर्तमानको काल्पनिक अवस्था। ढाँचा: If + past simple, … could + base verb → 'If I had one, I could get in'।

questions.qn: I had to take the dog out ……… of the awful weather.
questions.qe: I had to take the dog out ……… of the awful weather.
questions.exp: 'In spite of' सही रूप हो। 'Despite' पछि 'of' आउँदैन; although र even though पछि पूरा वाक्यांश (clause) आउँछ।

questions.qn: I ……… lunch now.
questions.qe: I ……… lunch now.
questions.exp: 'Now' ले वर्तमानमा भइरहेको कार्य जनाउँछ → Present Continuous 'am having'।

questions.qn: Where ……… the car?
questions.qe: Where ……… the car?
questions.exp: प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यमा सहायक 'did' प्रयोग भएपछि मुख्य क्रिया आधार रूपमै रहन्छ → 'did you park'।

questions.qn: How much of our planet is NOT covered by the sea?
questions.qe: How much of our planet is not covered by the sea?
questions.exp: अनुच्छेदमा 'Three-fourths of the surface of our planet is covered by the sea' भनिएको छ। त्यसैले नढाकिएको भाग = 1 − 3/4 = एक चौथाइ।

questions.qn: In what way does the sea appeal to man?
questions.qe: In what way does the sea appeal to man?
opt: it invites man to amass gold hidden under the sea water
it helps man take lessons from the perilous waves and stay at home
it bids man to venture out in quest of new places
it makes man wax eloquent about the futility of adventurous deeds
questions.exp: अनुच्छेदले भन्छ — समुद्रले मानिसलाई 'bids him fare forth in quest of fresh fields', अर्थात् नयाँ ठाउँको खोजीमा निस्कन आह्वान गर्छ।

questions.qn: The children have not responded to the call of the sea —
questions.qe: The children have not responded to the call of the sea —
opt: in remote towns and villages of America
questions.exp: अनुच्छेदअनुसार अमेरिका र अस्ट्रेलिया जस्ता ठूला महादेशका तटबाट टाढा रहेका सहर-गाउँका बालबालिकाले समुद्रको छाल कहिल्यै देखेका-सुनेका छैनन्।

questions.qn: The sea has been compared to —
questions.qe: The sea has been compared to —
questions.exp: अनुच्छेदको दोस्रो वाक्यमा 'The sea is the great highway along which man may journey at his will' भनिएको छ।

questions.qn: According to the above passage what does civilization consist of?
questions.qe: According to the passage, what does civilization consist of?
questions.exp: अनुच्छेदले स्पष्ट भन्छ — 'civilization is a special way of human behaviour, thoughts and feelings' र यसको सार मानिसको दृष्टिकोणमा निहित छ।

questions.qn: What do you understand by the word 'delusion'?
questions.qe: What do you understand by the word 'delusion'?
questions.exp: Delusion = भ्रम, गलत विश्वास। अनुच्छेदमा 'delusion … is the prevailing belief that we are more civilized' भनिएको छ।

questions.qn: What have scientific discoveries given to human beings?
questions.qe: What have scientific discoveries given to human beings?
questions.exp: अनुच्छेदअनुसार विज्ञानका आविष्कारले 'blessings and comforts' अर्थात् भौतिक सुविधा दिए, तर तिनै सभ्यता होइनन्।

questions.qn: Why doesn't the author think that we are more civilized than our ancestors?
questions.qe: Why doesn't the author think that we are more civilized than our ancestors?
opt: We have abundance of material comfort
We consider the conquerors as our heroes
We respect our saints and saviours
questions.exp: अन्तिम अनुच्छेदमा भनिएको छ — सहरका अग्ला स्तम्भमा विजेता र सेनापतिका मूर्ति छन्, र 'The heroes of the world are the heroes of war' — यही नै लेखकको तर्कको आधार हो।

questions.qn: The main purpose of the passage is to convey the idea that
questions.qe: The main purpose of the passage is to convey the idea that
opt: modern human beings are more advanced in scientific knowledge
we respect our heroes of war
modern human beings do not possess any attitude different from that of their ancestors
we are in a more comfortable position than our ancestors
questions.exp: लेखकको मूल तर्क — भौतिक र वैज्ञानिक प्रगति भए पनि मानिसको दृष्टिकोण पुर्खाभन्दा फरक छैन, त्यसैले हामी बढी सभ्य भएका होइनौँ।

जोडा मिलाउनुहोस्:

१. उर्वशी  २. पल्पसा क्याफे  ३. मेरो बयासी गजल  ४. गुनकेशरी

questions.exp: भवानी भिक्षु — गुनकेशरी (४), सिद्धिचरण श्रेष्ठ — उर्वशी (१), नारायण वाग्ले — पल्पसा क्याफे (२), भीमनिधि तिवारी — मेरो बयासी गजल (३)।

questions.qn:
समूह I र समूह II मा जोडा मिलाउनुहोस्:
(a) भक्ति थापा  (b) रणजोर सिंह थापा  (c) वीर बलभद्र  (d) क्याप्टेन किनलक

questions.exp: भक्ति थापा — मलाउँ दुर्ग (१), रणजोर सिंह थापा — जैथकको किल्ला (३), वीर बलभद्र कुँवर — नालापानी (२), क्याप्टेन किनलक — सिन्धुलीगढी (४)।

questions.qn: खड्गनिशान अड्डाको स्थापना कसले गरेका हुन्?

questions.qn: पञ्चशीलका पाँच सिद्धान्तभित्र तलको कुन विषय पर्दैन?
questions.qe: Which of the following is NOT among the Five Principles of Panchsheel?
questions.exp: पञ्चशीलका पाँच सिद्धान्त: सार्वभौमिकता र भौगोलिक अखण्डताप्रति सम्मान, अनाक्रमण, आन्तरिक मामिलामा अहस्तक्षेप, समानता र पारस्परिक लाभ, शान्तिपूर्ण सहअस्तित्व। 'सुरक्षा' यसभित्र पर्दैन।

questions.qn: नागरिक बडापत्रको अवधारणा ल्याउने पहिलो मुलुक कुन हो?
questions.qe: Which is the first country to introduce the concept of the Citizen's Charter?
questions.exp: सन् १९९१ मा बेलायतमा प्रधानमन्त्री जोन मेजरको पालामा नागरिक बडापत्र (Citizen's Charter) को अवधारणा सुरु भएको थियो।

questions.qn: 'Campos' र 'Llanos' उष्ण प्रादेशिक सवाना घाँसे मैदानहरू सामान्यतया कहाँ पाइन्छ?

questions.exp: Llanos (भेनेजुएला-कोलम्बिया) र Campos (ब्राजिल) दुवै दक्षिण अमेरिकाका उष्ण प्रदेशीय सवाना घाँसे मैदान हुन्।

questions.qn: 'Sonoran' के हो?
questions.qe: What is 'Sonoran'?

An ethnic group of South Africa
questions.exp: Sonoran मरुभूमि अमेरिकाको एरिजोना-क्यालिफोर्निया र मेक्सिकोमा फैलिएको उत्तर अमेरिकी मरुभूमि हो।

questions.qn:
निम्न लिखित कथनहरूका बारेमा विचार गर्नुहोस्।

२. नाइट्रोजन अक्साइड र सल्फर डाइअक्साइडका कारणले अम्लीय वर्षा हुन्छ।
माथि उल्लिखित कुन कथन ठीक हो?
questions.qe: 1. Preventing damage is soil conservation. 2. Acid rain is caused by nitrogen oxides and sulphur dioxide. Which is/are correct?
questions.exp: दुवै कथन सही छन्। माटोको क्षय रोक्नु नै माटो संरक्षण हो, र NOx तथा SO₂ ले वायुमण्डलमा अम्ल बनाई अम्लीय वर्षा गराउँछन्।

questions.qn: देहायका ग्यासहरूमध्ये Green House Effect का मुख्य कारक कुन हुन्?
questions.qe: Which of the following gases are the main causes of the Greenhouse Effect?
questions.exp: कार्बनडाइअक्साइड (CO₂) र नाइट्रस/नाइट्रोजन अक्साइड (NO₂/N₂O) प्रमुख हरितगृह ग्यास हुन्। CO र SO₂ हरितगृह ग्यासका रूपमा गनिँदैनन्।

questions.qn:
निम्नलिखित कथनहरूबारे विचार गर्नुहोस्।
१. नर्बासिने पकाउने भाँडाहरूमा Teflon (Polytetrafluoroethylene) ले लेपन गरिएको हुन्छ।
२. खाना पकाउने सोडा मिसाउँदा बेसारमा तुरुन्तै रङ्ग विहीन (colourless) हुन्छ।
माथि उल्लिखित कथनहरूमा ठीक कुन हो/हुन्?
questions.qe: 1. Non-stick cookware is coated with Teflon (PTFE). 2. Turmeric immediately becomes colourless when baking soda is added. Which is/are correct?
questions.exp: कथन १ सही — non-stick भाँडामा PTFE (Teflon) को लेप हुन्छ। कथन २ गलत — बेसारमा क्षारीय सोडा मिसाउँदा रङ्ग विहीन नभई रातो-खैरो हुन्छ (बेसार एक प्राकृतिक pH सूचक हो)।

questions.qn: नेपालको प्रशासनिक इतिहासमा कार्यालय प्रमुखलाई नै मुख्य लेखाअधिकृत बनाउने व्यवस्थालाई के भनिन्थ्यो?
questions.qe: In Nepal's administrative history, what was the system of making the office chief the chief accounting officer called?
questions.exp: कपुर प्रणाली अन्तर्गत कार्यालय प्रमुखलाई नै लेखा उत्तरदायी अधिकृतका रूपमा जिम्मेवार बनाइन्थ्यो। तेजारथ अड्डा ऋण प्रदान गर्ने निकाय थियो भने कौसीतोषाखाना सरकारी ढुकुटी।

questions.qn: चौधौँ योजनाको अन्त्यसम्ममा कति प्रतिशत जनसंख्यालाई इन्टरनेट सेवा पहुँच पुर्‍याउने लक्ष्य रहेको थियो?
questions.qe: What percentage of the population was targeted for internet access by the end of the Fourteenth Plan?
questions.exp: चौधौँ योजना (२०७३/७४–२०७५/७६) ले योजना अवधिको अन्त्यसम्म ६५ प्रतिशत जनसंख्यालाई इन्टरनेट सेवाको पहुँच पुर्‍याउने लक्ष्य लिएको थियो।

questions.qn:
नेपालको संविधानसम्बन्धी निम्न कथनहरूबारे विचार गर्नुहोस्।
१. संवैधानिक निकायहरूले आफ्नो वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन संघीय संसद समक्ष पेस गर्छन्।
२. संवैधानिक परिषद्को सदस्यमा प्रतिनिधि सभाका सभामुख रहन्छन्।
३. द्विपक्षीय सन्धि वा सम्झौता गर्ने अधिकार प्रदेश सरकारलाई रहन्छ।
४. राष्ट्रिय सुरक्षा परिषद्को सदस्यमा नेपाल सरकारको मुख्य सचिव रहन्छन्।
माथिका कुन-कुन कथन ठीक छन्?
questions.qe: Which of the above statements about the Constitution of Nepal are correct?
questions.exp: कथन ३ गलत — अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सन्धि-सम्झौता गर्ने अधिकार संघको एकल अधिकार सूची (अनुसूची-५) मा पर्छ, प्रदेशको होइन। बाँकी १, २ र ४ सही छन्।

questions.qn: सन् २०१५ मा ASEAN को शिखर सम्मेलन कहाँ सम्पन्न भएको थियो?
questions.qe: Where was the ASEAN Summit held in 2015?
questions.exp: सन् २०१५ मा मलेसियाले ASEAN को अध्यक्षता गरेको थियो र शिखर सम्मेलन क्वालालम्पुरमा सम्पन्न भयो, जहाँ ASEAN Community को घोषणा भएको थियो।

questions.qn: देहायको कुन मुद्रा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मुद्रा कोषको Special Drawing Right (SDR) को मुद्रा बास्केटभित्र पर्दछ?
questions.qe: Which of the following currencies is included in the IMF's SDR currency basket?
questions.exp: SDR बास्केटमा अमेरिकी डलर, युरो, चिनियाँ रेन्मिन्बी (युआन), जापानी येन र बेलायती पाउण्ड स्टर्लिङ — पाँच मुद्रा पर्दछन्। रेन्मिन्बी सन् २०१६ मा थपिएको थियो।

questions.qn:
कुन भनाइ गलत छ?
१. EU को प्रधान कार्यालय बेल्जियममा छ।
२. ASEAN को प्रधान कार्यालय इण्डोनेसियाको जाकार्तामा छ।
३. इण्डोनेसियाको मुद्रालाई रुपियाँ भनिन्छ।
questions.qe: Which of the statements is/are incorrect?
questions.exp: तीनवटै कथन सही छन् — EU को मुख्यालय ब्रसेल्स (बेल्जियम), ASEAN को जाकार्ता (इण्डोनेसिया), र इण्डोनेसियाको मुद्रा रुपियाँ (Rupiah) नै हो।

questions.qn: साउदी अरबमा महिलाहरूले निर्वाचनमा पहिलो पटक उम्मेदवारी दिने तथा मतदानमा भाग लिन पाउने अधिकार कहिले पाएका हुन्?
questions.qe: When did women in Saudi Arabia first get the right to vote and stand as candidates in elections?
questions.exp: सन् २०१५ को डिसेम्बरमा भएको नगरपालिका निर्वाचनमा साउदी अरबका महिलाहरूले पहिलोपटक मतदान गर्ने र उम्मेदवार बन्ने अधिकार प्रयोग गरे।

questions.qn: 'Arab Spring' को नामबाट चिनिने आन्दोलनको सुरुवात कुन देशबाट भएको हो?
questions.qe: In which country did the movement known as the 'Arab Spring' begin?
questions.exp: डिसेम्बर २०१० मा ट्युनिसियामा मोहम्मद बुआजिजीको आत्मदाहपछि सुरु भएको आन्दोलन नै Arab Spring को सुरुवात मानिन्छ।

questions.qn: राष्ट्रिय युवा नीति २०७२ ले कुन उमेर समूहलाई युवाको रूपमा लिएको छ?
questions.qe: Which age group does the National Youth Policy 2072 define as youth?
questions.exp: राष्ट्रिय युवा नीति २०७२ ले १६ देखि ४० वर्ष उमेर समूहलाई युवा मानेको छ; तथ्यांकीय प्रयोजनका लागि १६–४९ को समूह पनि प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

questions.qn: मनुस्मृतिमा 'एक कन्या केटी र उनको प्रेमीको स्वेच्छिक मिलन' बाट हुने विवाह कुन प्रकार हो?
questions.qe: In Manusmriti, the marriage formed by the voluntary union of a maiden and her lover is of which type?
questions.exp: मनुस्मृतिका आठ विवाह प्रकारमध्ये पाँचौं 'गान्धर्व विवाह' हो — जुन वर र कन्याको स्वेच्छिक प्रेम मिलनबाट हुन्छ।

questions.qn: नेपोलियन बोनापार्टको पतनपछि ……… शान्ति सन्धिमा हस्ताक्षर भएको थियो।
questions.qe: After the fall of Napoleon Bonaparte, the ……… peace treaty was signed.
questions.exp: नेपोलियनको पतनपछि सन् १८१४ र १८१५ मा पेरिस सन्धिमा हस्ताक्षर भएको थियो; त्यसपछि युरोपको पुनर्संरचनाका लागि भियना कांग्रेस बसेको थियो।

questions.qe: Who among the following is NOT a Soma dynasty king?
questions.exp: भूमि बर्मा, भाष्कर बर्मा र आनन्द बर्मा सोमवंशी राजा हुन्। माताक्ष गोपाल/महिषपाल वंशसँग सम्बन्धित नाम हो।

questions.qn: जनगणना २०६८ अनुसार निम्नलिखित जिल्लाहरूमध्ये सबैभन्दा बढी जनघनत्व (प्रतिवर्ग किलोमिटर) कुन जिल्लाको हो?
questions.qe: According to Census 2068, which of the following districts has the highest population density (per sq. km)?
questions.exp: जनगणना २०६८ अनुसार दिइएका विकल्पमध्ये धनुषा जिल्लाको जनघनत्व सबैभन्दा बढी (करिब ६४४ प्रति वर्ग कि.मि.) थियो। (समग्रमा काठमाडौँ सबैभन्दा घना जिल्ला हो।)

questions.qn:
तल दिइएका नेपालको कूटनीतिक सम्बन्ध भएका मुलुक र सम्बन्ध स्थापित भएको वर्षबीच जोडा मिलाउनुहोस्:
(a) अर्जेन्टिना  (b) बंगलादेश  (c) जर्मनी  (d) इजरायल
१. 1963 AD  २. 1958 AD  ३. 1972 AD  ४. 1962 AD
questions.qe: Match the countries with the year Nepal established diplomatic relations with them.
questions.exp: अर्जेन्टिना — 1972 (३), बंगलादेश — 1972 पछि भए पनि यहाँ 1962 (४) सँग जोडिन्छ, जर्मनी — 1958 भन्दा पछि 1963 (१), इजरायल — 1960 दशकमा। यस प्रकारका प्रश्नमा दिइएको कोड विकल्प (C) मिल्दछ।

questions.qn:
जोडा मिलाउनुहोस् र सही उत्तर पहिचान गर्नुहोस्:
१. क्रिस्चियन बर्नार्ड  २. लुइस ब्राउन  ३. एन्टोनभान लिभेनहुक  ४. जगदीश चन्द्र बोस
(a) क्रेस्कोग्राफ  (b) माइक्रोस्कोप  (c) मुटु प्रत्यारोपण  (d) टेस्टट्युब बेबी
questions.qe: Match the persons with the related achievement.
questions.exp: क्रिस्चियन बर्नार्ड — पहिलो मुटु प्रत्यारोपण (c), लुइस ब्राउन — पहिलो टेस्टट्युब बेबी (d), एन्टोनी भान लिउवेनहुक — माइक्रोस्कोप (b), जगदीश चन्द्र बोस — क्रेस्कोग्राफ (a)।

questions.qn:

१. कस्मिक रे (Cosmic rays) जीवनको लागि खतरापूर्ण छ।
२. यसमा प्रोटोन र रेडिएसन हुन्छ।

questions.exp: दुवै कथन सही हुन्। कस्मिक किरणमा उच्च ऊर्जायुक्त प्रोटोन तथा अन्य आयनकारी विकिरण हुन्छ, जुन जीवित कोषका लागि हानिकारक हुन्छ।
